papers.title: Dual Control for Approximate Bayesian Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Control of non-episodic, finite-horizon dynamical systems with uncertain dynamics poses a tough and elementary case of the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Bayesian reinforcement learning, reasoning about the effect of actions and future observations, offers a principled solution, but is intractable. We review, then extend an old approximate approach from control theory---where the problem is known as dual control---in the context of modern regression methods, specifically generalized linear regression. Experiments on simulated systems show that this framework offers a useful approximation to the intractable aspects of Bayesian RL, producing structured exploration strategies that differ from standard RL approaches. We provide simple examples for the use of this framework in (approximate) Gaussian process regression and feedforward neural networks for the control of exploration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及贝叶斯强化学习与双控制，与有限元代理模型或植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on reinforcement learning for control of dynamical systems, with no mention of finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification for biomechanics, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非周期性有限时域动态系统的不确定性控制问题
summary_zh.method: 将经典双控制理论与广义线性回归结合近似贝叶斯强化学习
summary_zh.result: 在模拟系统中产生了与标准方法不同的结构化探索策略
summary_zh.validation: 在简单模拟系统上的数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To address the exploration-exploitation tradeoff in non-episodic finite-horizon dynamical systems with uncertain dynamics.
summary_en.method: Extends the classical dual control approach from control theory using modern regression methods such as Gaussian processes and neural networks to approximate Bayesian reinforcement learning.
summary_en.result: Produces structured exploration strategies distinct from standard RL approaches in simulated systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on simulated dynamical systems.

papers.title: Defects-tolerant Co-Cr-Mo dental alloys prepared by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials and Environmental Chemistry, Arrhenius Laboratory, Stockholm University, S-106 91 Stockholm, Sweden

corresponding_authors.name: Zhifu Shen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials and Environmental Chemistry, Arrhenius Laboratory, Stockholm University, S-106 91 Stockholm, Sweden. Electronic address: shen@mmk.su.se

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了牙科用钴铬钼合金的选择性激光熔化制备和缺陷容忍性，虽然涉及LPBF和力学测试，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或骨整合，且针对牙科而非髋关节植入物。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue behavior, surface roughness for osseointegration, or hip implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究牙科用Co-Cr-Mo合金的缺陷容忍性以提高可靠性
summary_zh.method: 通过选择性激光熔化制备合金并进行力学测试
summary_zh.result: 展示了合金的缺陷容忍性和良好的力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证缺陷容忍性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the defect tolerance of Co-Cr-Mo dental alloys produced by selective laser melting for improved reliability.
summary_en.method: Alloy specimens were fabricated using selective laser melting and subjected to mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The alloy demonstrated defect tolerance and favorable mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing of as-built specimens.

papers.title: Preventing sepsis in total hip arthroplasty

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注全髋关节置换术后感染的预防，与用户研究的植入物生物力学完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper addresses clinical infection prevention strategies, not implant biomechanics, stress shielding, micromotion, or finite element analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 预防全髋关节置换术后感染
summary_zh.method: 综述现有预防策略和临床证据
summary_zh.result: 提出综合预防方案以减少感染风险
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体实验或模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To prevent postoperative sepsis after total hip arthroplasty through a review of current strategies.
summary_en.method: A narrative review of infection prevention measures including antibiotic prophylaxis, surgical techniques, and patient optimization.
summary_en.result: Combined preventive approaches are recommended to reduce infection rates.
summary_en.validation: No specific experimental or simulation validation is presented; the paper is a clinical review.
